source_note: 仅画奈良唐招提寺金堂，正面近实景。寺院官方明确金堂为奈良时代8世纪后半叶、七间×四间、寄栋造、本瓦葺，前面一间敞廊；759是鉴真开寺，不是金堂已竣工的证据。图版保留单层寄栋屋顶、两端鸱尾与正面8柱形成的7间。
prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


Subject: ONLY the Kondo (Golden Hall) of Toshodaiji Temple, Nara, Japan (唐招提寺金堂). Image1 is the Buddha STYLE MASTER ONLY. Image2 is the actual near-frontal photograph and is the exact complete geometry authority. Image3 is a close photograph of the same hall's ridge-end shibi ornament, use only its shape, not its dense roof-tile texture. Preserve the actual Japanese Nara-period architecture.
Draw ONE broad low wooden hall with a SINGLE great HIPPED ROOF (Japanese yosemune-zukuri / 寄棟造), not a hip-and-gable roof. No upper gable, no second roof tier, no extra mokoshi apron or tower. The wide front roof slope rises gently to a long horizontal ridge with exactly TWO distinctive simple curved tail-shaped shibi ornaments, one at each ridge end. These are simple sweeping fish-tail-like profiles from Image3, not Chinese dragon heads. Roof corners lift only gently as in the real photo. No central finial or pagoda spire.
The facade is exactly SEVEN BAYS with EIGHT main round wooden columns standing in one front row: four columns to the left of the center axis and four to the right, enclosing a wider central bay. Do not add a column at the center. These columns carry a continuous bracket band of Japanese three-step projecting bracket complexes. The front is an OPEN VERANDA one bay deep, with the wall and doors behind the front row of columns. Keep the actual rear wall's five central openings and simple vertical lattice windows toward the ends, sparsely represented. Columns have the subtle swelling of the actual timber shafts. Do not replace them with carved stone columns. Retain the white-plaster infill between dark-in-photo timber members but use no dark fills. Omit all hanging curtains with repeated family emblems; show the bare door outlines behind them.
Keep the simple broad low stone plinth and a broad central stairway as photographed. Remove the stone lantern in front of the center, people, trees, shrubs, fence, handrails, neighboring buildings and all modern signage. No words, emblems, labels or watermark. All door/window interiors remain WHITE.
Use very sparse thin contour linework like Image1, with mainly continuous delicate outlines and generous white areas. The enormous roof plane is almost blank: only about8 widely separated direction strokes total, NOT parallel lines for every row of tiles. No tile grid, no hatch, no black shadows beneath the eaves. Simplify bracket groups to legible silhouettes and only essential joints. Keep actual seven-bay rhythm and one roof. Landscape1536x1024, nearly exactly front elevation, verticals vertical, entire building width1200pixels centered with at least150pixels pure white margin beyond both roof tips. All roof ornaments, eaves and plinth fully uncut, generous top and bottom blank space.

historical_sources.supports: 国宝，奈良时代8世纪后半叶；寄栋造、本瓦葺；正面7间、进深4间、前面一间敞廊及三手先组物。
759年鉴真创寺；金堂在8世纪后半叶由弟子如宝等努力完成，明确区分寺院创建和金堂落成。

site_recommendation.name: 唐招提寺
site_recommendation.year_note: 780仅为8世纪后半叶近似排序点，并非有确切记载的竣工年；不以759建寺年替代现存金堂年代。
site_recommendation.place: 日本 · 奈良县 · 奈良市
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 金堂类别公开位置34°40′31.87″N、135°47′05.28″E换算；公开地图近似位置。
site_recommendation.lede: 八根圆柱撑起唐招提寺金堂宽展的单檐屋顶，殿前敞廊把庭院与佛像所在的内室隔出一层安静的过渡。鉴真创寺之后，弟子们在8世纪后半叶完成这座金堂。
facts: 鉴真于759年开创唐招提寺，现存金堂则建于8世纪后半叶；寺院官方将其营建与弟子如宝联系起来。
金堂正面七间、进深四间，采用寄栋造（庑殿顶），铺本瓦葺，前面一间敞开形成柱廊。
檐下三手先组物承托深远屋檐，屋脊两端的鸱尾与宽阔单檐共同构成外观特征。

verification: 已view_image核验母版、完整近正面照片、同殿鸱尾细节和生成输出。单层寄栋屋顶无山花或第二檐，正面8根主圆柱形成7开间，中央无柱；2个脊端鸱尾、宽低台基和中央台阶保留，屋面疏朗无填黑。主体与两侧檐尖完整未裁切，人物、前景石灯笼、幔幕纹样及邻殿已去除。
